name: Alibaba Cloud DirectMail
line: Email delivery for app messages and consent-based batch campaigns.

subs.math: 4,000 emails a month, each to one recipient, at $0.29 per 1,000 = $1.16 a month. This is the ongoing cost after the one-time free quota is used.
20,000 emails a month, each to one recipient, at $0.29 per 1,000 = $5.80 a month. This is the ongoing cost after the one-time free quota is used.
40,000 emails a month, each to one recipient, at $0.29 per 1,000 = $11.60 a month. This is the ongoing cost after the one-time free quota is used.
200,000 emails a month, each to one recipient, at $0.29 per 1,000 = $58.00 a month. This is the ongoing cost after the one-time free quota is used.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails a month at $0.29 per 1,000 = $0.87 a month, about 100 a day over 30 days. Counted after the free quota. Assumes one recipient per email, no attachments and no tax.
10,000 emails a month at $0.29 per 1,000 = $2.90 a month, about 334 a day over 30 days. Counted after the free quota. Assumes one recipient per email, no attachments and no tax.
50,000 emails a month at $0.29 per 1,000 = $14.50 a month, about 1,667 a day over 30 days. Counted after the free quota. Assumes one recipient per email, no attachments and no tax.
100,000 emails a month at $0.29 per 1,000 = $29.00 a month, about 3,334 a day over 30 days. Counted after the free quota. Assumes one recipient per email, no attachments and no tax.
